claim: You can specify up to five Amazon EC2 instance types for each EMR instance fleet in the AWS Management Console, or a maximum of 30 types per instance fleet when you create a cluster using the AWS CLI or Amazon EMR API and an allocation strategy for instance fleets.
question: EMR instance fleets: how many instance types can a fleet use in the console versus the API or CLI?

values.display: up to five Amazon EC2 instance types
values.spoken: up to five EC2 instance types

values.display: a maximum of 30 types per instance fleet
values.spoken: a maximum of thirty types per instance fleet

qualifiers.scope: EC2 instance types per EMR instance fleet; 30 applies to the AWS CLI or EMR API with an allocation strategy for instance fleets
qualifiers.condition: Five in the console; 30 with the CLI or API and an allocation strategy.
